definitions.explanation: The proportion of employees who leave a company or an occupation within a given period. Often cited for new graduates leaving within three years.

examples.japanese: {離職率|りしょくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{離職率|りしょくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This company is known for its low staff turnover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離職率|りしょくりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The rate at which new graduates leave within three years varies greatly by industry.

notes:
⟦{離職|りしょく}→離職：16383_rishoku⟧ (leaving one's job) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate). A standard figure in job-hunting guides and labor statistics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離職率|りしょくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧・⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high / low turnover
- {離職率|りしょくりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to reduce turnover
- ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧{離職率|りしょくりつ}: early-departure rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定着率|ていちゃくりつ}: retention rate — the share who stay, the reverse view of the same figure
- ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: job-change rate — counts people who move to another job
